summary: Frontend-only test of the GlobalDmPrompt overlay (approved 24 Jun 2026). Group copy, dismiss-preserves-badge, /dm/{convId} exclusion, group Open→/chats navigation, and UI freeze all PASS. However, code review + confirmed API-shape mismatch reveals a HIGH-priority defect: DmNotifyProvider reads `c.last_message?.created_at || c.last_message_at` but the backend `/api/dm/{uid}/conversations` endpoint returns `last` (not `last_message`) and has no `last_message_at` field, so `messageTs`/`newestTs` are ALWAYS empty string. This breaks P0#4 (a newer incoming message on a previously-dismissed conversation cannot re-arm the prompt, because the dismissed-key `single:{convId}:` / `group::N` never changes). First-show behaviour is unaffected which is why the visual tests still saw prompts.

ui_bugs.issue: Reads `c.last_message?.created_at || c.last_message_at` but the API returns `last` (not `last_message`) and no `last_message_at` — so messageTs/newestTs are always empty string. Dismissed-set keys therefore never change on a new incoming message → previously-dismissed prompts NEVER re-arm even when a fresh DM arrives (P0#4). Fix: read `c.last?.created_at || c.updated_at || ''` (endpoint at /app/backend/server.py:8528,8544 confirms field name is `last`).

integration_issues.issue: Because messageTs='' always, the dismissed key is stable per-conv (single) or per-count (group). A new message on the same conv (single) or the same total count (group) will remain suppressed for the entire session. Manual re-seed after dismissal was performed; the group prompt did not re-appear on the next poll cycle even after inserting a fresh maggie DM (unread_count went to 3, but total-conv-count stayed at 2, so `group::2` remained dismissed).

action_items: HIGH: In /app/frontend/src/lib/dm-notify-context.tsx replace `c.last_message?.created_at || c.last_message_at || ''` with `c.last?.created_at || c.updated_at || ''` (two call sites: single at line ~120, group reduce at line ~136). This is the minimal change that lets a newer message change the dismissed-set key and re-arm the prompt (P0#4).

OPTIONAL: consider keying the group dismissal on the newest message timestamp AND count together (already the code intent), so if count is unchanged but a newer message arrives, the key still bumps. The fix above is sufficient because updated_at bumps on every new DM (see server.py:9142).
critical_code_review_comments: Field-name mismatch: backend contract (server.py:8544) returns `last` inside the conv objects; provider expects `last_message`. Silent contract drift — no unit test catches it because the first show works with empty-string ts.

`_pick_prompt` correctly excludes `viewingConvId` and correctly falls back to a single-kind prompt if only one eligible conv remains after that filter — verified visually (Frank prompt shown while inside Maggie's DM).

Composer-lock integrations present in all 7 required files: app/table/[id].tsx:73, app/dm/[id].tsx:35, app/notices.tsx:50, app/events/new.tsx:61, GeorgeOnboarding.tsx:74, GeorgeEventCreation.tsx:134, VoiceInputButton.tsx:443.
Hidden-path allow-list (`/`, `/auth/*`, `/onboarding`, `/waitlist`) matches George's HIDDEN_SCREENS — checked in GlobalDmPrompt.tsx:41-48.
AppState.change listener re-fires load() on `active` and clears the interval on background — code path is correct.

Provider re-renders only when `prompt`, `openTarget`, `dismiss`, or `composerBusy` change; the composer-busy gate is applied at the `value` memo (line 276) — deferral works without reshaping state, good.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — 6/7 visually verified P0 tests pass; P0#4 fails due to field-name bug

Usage: `MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database python /app/backend/tests/seed_dm.py --sender maggie --text 'hi'`. Verified working: seeded 2 convs (maggie + frankie) to Alex to reproduce the group prompt.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login as Alex (member@friendplace.com.au / TestPass2026!). To seed a DM without a second browser, run the seed script above. Chats-tab-unread badge appears on ANY tabbed screen; the prompt appears on ANY authed screen except /, /auth/*, /onboarding, /waitlist. Visual tests confirmed group prompt copy 'You have N new private chats', dismiss preserves badge, and group Open→/chats. The single-conv Open→/dm/{convId}?other_id= route was not visually clicked but the code path in dm-notify-context.tsx:249-256 is straightforward. The re-arm failure is deterministic (messageTs='' always).
rca_of_issue: RCA: The `/api/dm/{uid}/conversations` endpoint (server.py:8481-8548) returns each conversation with a `last` sub-object containing the most recent message; the frontend DmNotifyProvider was written expecting `last_message` + a `last_message_at` top-level field. Neither exists, so `c.last_message?.created_at || c.last_message_at || ''` always resolves to `''`. Because the dismissed-set key encodes this timestamp (`single:${convId}:${messageTs}` / `group:${newestTs}:${count}`), the key never changes across new messages → a dismissed prompt cannot be re-armed for the same conversation (single) or the same total conv count (group). Reproduction: seed unread DM → prompt shows → tap 'Not now' → seed another DM to the same recipient (any sender that keeps total-conv-count the same) → wait >15 s → prompt does NOT re-appear. Mitigation: replace both timestamp reads in `_pick_prompt` with `c.last?.created_at || c.updated_at || ''`. `updated_at` on the conversation doc is bumped by the WS message handler (server.py:9142) on every incoming DM, so this alone is sufficient to guarantee key bump on any new message.
